catalog.method: GET fixed URL with User-Agent IRFAN VPN; body is one AES-256-GCM envelope (password II) whose plaintext is a ConfigData JSON object; every string field inside is itself an envelope decrypted with password I
catalog.notes: The live response is chunked and the connection can cut mid-body; the analysis script retries and falls back to curl, but the broker download is a single GET (the endpoint answers 200 with the full body on a normal HTTP client).

files.method: Same double-envelope layout as the catalog (password II outer, password I per field)
